Let the forearms return until triceps are loaded, not shoulders.
common_errors: Using the torso to press the weight down.
Letting elbows drift forward and back.
Snapping into lockout with poor control.
use_when: Direct triceps volume is needed.
Pressing lockout or arm hypertrophy is a priority.
A joint-friendly accessory is preferred after heavy presses.
avoid_when: Pressdowns irritate elbows.
The athlete cannot keep shoulders quiet.

name: Wall Slide with Lift-Off
summary: Low-load wall drill for overhead shoulder motion, serratus contribution, and scapular upward-rotation control.
coaching_cues: Stand with ribs down and forearms on the wall.
Slide upward without arching the low back.
Lift hands lightly from the wall only if shoulder blades stay controlled.
common_errors: Arching the back to create overhead range.
Forcing lift-off when the wall slide is not controlled.
use_when: Overhead pressing needs a preparatory activation drill.
Scapular upward rotation is a coaching focus.
Low-load mobility and control work is appropriate.
avoid_when: Overhead motion causes pain or tingling.
The athlete cannot keep ribs down against the wall.
